name: Cafe Central
description: Cozy neighborhood cafe with fast wifi, quiet corner tables, and specialty coffee. Popular with people working on laptops in the afternoon.

name: Coworking Paulista
description: Modern coworking space with drop-in day passes, meeting rooms, and a coffee bar. Bright, open floor plan and reliable wifi.

name: Padaria Bella Vista
description: Traditional bakery and cafe serving pastries and coffee, with a few outdoor tables. Casual, quick stop, moderately busy in the morning.

name: Livraria Cultura Cafe
description: Bookstore cafe with a calm, quiet ambiance, good for reading or working. Comfortable seating and specialty tea and coffee.

name: Espaco Compartilhado Jardins
description: Boutique coworking space in Jardins with private booths and a small cafe counter. Good for short waits and quick calls.

name: Cafe da Praca
description: Casual outdoor cafe facing the square, lively atmosphere, simple coffee and snacks. Good people-watching, can get noisy on weekends.
